config.label: Base URL of your ICTExam site, e
config.description: Base URL of your ICTExam site, e.g. https://app.ictlms.net (no trailing /api).

config.label: A teacher or admin account email
config.description: A teacher or admin account email.

config.label: Path the API is mounted under
config.description: Path the API is mounted under. Defaults to /api (behind the usual reverse proxy). Set empty to talk to the backend port directly.

config.label: Unlocks the write tools: parse a paper with AI (spends server AI credit), publish and unpublish exams
config.description: Unlocks the write tools: parse a paper with AI (spends server AI credit), publish and unpublish exams. When false these tools are not registered at all. Leave off unless you mean it.

config.label: Per request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000 (AI parsing can be slow).

config.label: Skip TLS certificate verification
config.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for a self-signed test server.
